demo.title: odq-crypto-data.sh
demo.code:
# EVM wallet snapshot: live balance + last 5 txs ($0.0002)
curl -s "$BASE/wallet-watch?address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045&chain=eth" | python3 -m json.tool

BASE=https://x402.bankr.bot/0xf436ca41bd0a236338bef57adeb4976677513010

# Momentum snapshot for any coin ($0.0005)
curl -s "$BASE/market-signal?coin=bitcoin" | python3 -m json.tool

# Perp market regime for BTC/ETH/SOL ($0.003)
curl -s "$BASE/crypto-sentinel?symbol=BTC" | python3 -m json.tool

# Funding APR heatmap, 15 Binance perps ($0.004)
curl -s "$BASE/funding-heatmap" | python3 -m json.tool

# DEX pair scan for any EVM token ($0.005)
curl -s "$BASE/pair-scan?token=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913" | python3 -m json.tool

# Rug-safety screen 0-100 with auditable flags ($0.01)
curl -s "$BASE/token-safety?token=0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913" | python3 -m json.tool

# First call returns HTTP 402 + payment requirements (x402 v2, USDC on Base).
# Sign EIP-3009 and retry with the X-PAYMENT header, or use any x402 SDK.

setup: No install required — every endpoint is plain HTTP behind x402 (protocol v2)
Fund a Base wallet with USDC (prices from $0.0005/req; no gas needed — facilitator settles)
Or use an x402-aware runtime (Bankr terminal, x402-axios, x402 SDKs) that signs and pays automatically
Worked manual-payment example in references/endpoints.md; responses embed sources + methodology + disclaimer
